title: Delay in claim intimation/documents submission with respect to i.All Life insurance contracts and ii.All Non-Life individual and group insurance contracts

**Dated:** 28<sup>th</sup> October, 2016. 

# **To: All Life Insurers, Non-Life Insurers & Health Insurance Cos** 

**Re: Delay in claim intimation/documents submission with respect to i. All Life insurance contracts and** 

**ii. All Non-Life individual and group insurance contracts** 

This is further to the circular , issued by the Authority with ref: IRDA/HL TH/MISC/CIR/216/09/2011 dated 20.09.2011, in the matter of dealing with claims where there is delay in intimation/document submission. 

The above referred circular is to be deemed as a direction issued by the Authority under Section 34(1) of the Insurance Act, 1938 and insurers are bound to comply with the same. 

**P.J.Joseph Member (Non- Life)** ~
